summary: Instance groups can be assigned to organizations, inventories and job templates, checked in the order Job Template > Inventory > Organization; custom groups in the installer inventory use the instance_group_ prefix and members must also be in automationcontroller or execution_nodes, with automationcontroller shown as controlplane.
questions: Which instance group does a job use if several are set?
What is the instance group precedence in AAP?
How do I define a custom instance group in the installer inventory?
What is the controlplane instance group?

answer_card.title: Instance group precedence
answer_card.answer_md:
Instance groups can be set on job templates, inventories and organizations. When a job runs, controller checks them in this order:

**Job Template > Inventory > Organization**

If none is set, the job falls back to the `default` instance group. In the installer inventory, custom groups are named `instance_group_<name>` and their hosts must also be in `[automationcontroller]` or `[execution_nodes]`.
